summary: Frontend-only regression + feature validation for TEAM PAGE V2 (NHL Minnesota Wild) at /team/MIN and legacy-layout regression at /team/KAM?league=whl. All approved features render and navigate correctly; no console errors beyond an unrelated RN 'shadow*' deprecation warning. V2 layout is correctly gated to NHL — non-NHL leagues still show the legacy banner/season-strip layout.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Non-blocking but should be cleaned up. Reference: shared style objects across app/team/[id].tsx and shared UI components using shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset.

action_items: Optional: sweep RN styles and replace shadow* props with boxShadow (or platform-gated) to silence the deprecation warning on web.

Optional testability: the V2 Next Game opponent Pressables don't expose a dedicated testID (only the abbr text is used). Consider adding testID={`next-team-${abbr}`} inside NhlTeamV2 (line ~499/508 in /app/frontend/app/team/[id].tsx) to mirror the legacy TeamTap component and simplify automation.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/team/[id].tsx is ~665 lines with two large layouts in one file — consider splitting NhlTeamV2 into /app/frontend/src/components/team/NhlTeamV2.tsx to keep files <700 lines and improve maintainability.

Backend endpoint /api/nhl/team/MIN returns `recent: []` in the current fixture, so the 'Last Game' / 'Recent Results' V2 blocks are not currently exercised on Minnesota. Consider a fixture with at least one final so this branch is smoke-tested in future runs.

V2 next-game opponent Pressables and the desk PLAY/TALK controls all render and are tappable; the OUT-rail 'NEXT' tab uses key 'tonight' so its testID is `out-tonight` (not `out-next`) — worth documenting for future testers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: V2 layout path: `if (isNhl) return <NhlTeamV2 ... />` in /app/frontend/app/team/[id].tsx (line 44). V2 testIDs verified: crumb-league, crumb-division, follow-toggle, team-desk, desk-play, desk-talk, desk-stop, team-stats-rail, stat-PP%, stat-PK%, stat-FACEOFF%, stat-GF/GAME, stat-GA/GAME, team-next, division-team-<ABBR>, out-home, out-recap, out-tonight, out-stats. OUT-rail 'NEXT' key is `tonight`. Legacy layout (non-NHL) confirmed via /team/KAM?league=whl.
